theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the top eligible theme (rank 1, score 1.612) and the rotation leader, with strong breadth (0.786) suggesting leadership is broad rather than a single-name spike. Durability_bar 0.68 is the highest among top ranks, so the trend gate holds it as eligible. This is a stay-with-the-trend lean, not a buy call; crowding_z 1.04 flags it as crowded, which only argues for capping exposure, not fading.
theses.dissent: Crowding is high and hurst_tag is 'mixed', not cleanly trending; energy leadership can reverse quickly on one macro headline, and the track record's 0.343 direction accuracy says trend-following leans on this market have often been wrong.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its own 20-day average while Gold Miners (XGD.TO) is up over the same 2-week window

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the confirmed challenger (rank 2, score 1.11), eligible, and not crowded (z=0.2). It is the only theme within striking distance of the leader (margin 0.502). Durability_bar 0.48 is moderate and breadth 0.267 is narrow, so this is a weak trend-following lean rather than a rotation call — the detector does not predict a handoff.
theses.dissent: Breadth is thin (0.267) and hurst_tag 'mixed' — leadership may be concentrated in a few names and could stall; Gold Miners has no rotation-timing edge and could simply lag Oil & Gas if energy stays dominant.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO falls back below its 50-day average while XEG.TO makes a new 20-day high

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is ranked 8 with a negative score (-0.115) and is ineligible (below the absolute-trend gate). The validated edge is staying out of themes that fail the trend gate to avoid drawdown. Hurst 'trend' but negative score implies a downtrend; no reason to be long.
theses.dissent: In a risk-off or rate-cut shock, utilities could mean-revert sharply higher; avoiding is not a short, just no exposure, so it forfeits any snap-back.
